top_signals.title: Switzerland’s first spot Bitcoin ETF ticks up 0.6% in opening hour
top_signals.summary: The spot Bitcoin ETF will be backed by Bitcoin held in cold storage at a Swiss bank, unlike prior Bitcoin ETPs structured as debt securities.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: How Europe Comes Apart
top_signals.summary: The European Union is entering a period of political instability that could threaten its future—not through its formal dissolution, but through the gradual erosion of its capacity to act. In recent months, Europe has been engulfed in protests driven by a common crisis of affordability, deteriorating public services, and declining confidence in governments’ ability to improve living standards, especially for young people.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: U.S. chip curbs and distillation crackdown to impact Chinese AI model progress
top_signals.summary: American firms have made efforts to prevent use of their models to train others, while Washington has set out new rules for access to computing power.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
